extDescription.message: Turbo download accelerator and video sniffer. Sends downloads straight to the ZDM desktop app.

app_offline.message: ZDM is not running — start it and try again

popup_capture_hint.message: Confirmed downloads are handed to ZDM. If ZDM is offline the browser keeps downloading.

popup_help.message: Open the extension list and enable Developer mode, then use “Load unpacked” if the browser did not install ZDM automatically.
